name: git-safety
when_to_use: When executing git operations. Status before diff, diff before commit, never push without explicit approval.
steps: Run 'git status' to inspect working tree state.
Run 'git diff --stat' to review staged and unstaged modifications.
Display a concise summary of changes to the user before committing.
Request explicit interactive confirmation prior to 'git push' — never push autonomously.
Block force-push and destructive rebases unless explicitly directed by the user.
verification: git status confirms clean working tree
